en: A vintage, hand-colored postcard depicting a canal scene with a stone bridge, tree-lined quay, and historic European architecture along the water. The buildings are multi-storied, and one prominently displays the name 'A. Deneve & Cie.' on its façade. The canal reflects the bridge and surrounding buildings, and a horse-drawn carriage is visible on the right side. The style and quality of the postcard suggest it dates from the early 20th century.
